Alex: quick check — I'm reconciling the postmortem action list for INC-742. Can owners confirm they can hit their due dates and whether any upstream deps are blocking?
Priya: I own the rollout script update (item 3). ETA is Tue EOD unless infra needs extra time. I need confirmation on the metric export change from infra.
Jordan: pinging infra — @Maya or @Dan, do we have capacity to push the metric export change this week? :eyes:
Maya: we can do it but need the schema diff. send the snippet and we'll validate. slot available Thu morning.
Dan: Thu AM works for me too. FYI there is a migration window Thursday 03:00-05:00 UTC; avoid heavy batch jobs then.
Alex: noted — Priya, can you T-shirt the migration impact? small/medium/large and whether rollback is trivial.
Priya: small. steps below:
```
1) deploy exporter v2
2) toggle flag for 1% traffic
3) monitor logs for 15m
4) promote to 100%
```
Rollback: flip flag + redeploy v1. I can draft the runbook snippet.
Jordan: thanks. For action item 5 (canary routing policy) I assigned it to me but I need an owner for validation tests — @Maya? :pray:
Maya: I can validate routing tests after export change lands. timeline aligns.
Alex: ownership matrix update: (1) rollout script — Priya; (2) metric export — Maya/Infra; (3) canary tests — Jordan + Maya; (4) postmortem doc edits — Dan. Are we good to lock due dates?
Dan: locking my doc edits for Fri EOD. I'll add the sentences about followups and link the S3 bucket.
Priya: locking Tue EOD for rollout script. I'll open the PR after schema is posted.
Maya: locking Thu morning for export validation. Will post results in this thread.
inc-bot: Incident INC-742 — action items updated: Priya (item 3) due 1745173200, Maya (item 2) due 1745064000, Jordan (item 5) due 1745145600, Dan (item 4) due 1745251200.
Alex: thanks everyone. if any dependency slips, call it out in this thread and we'll reprioritize. I'll follow up with a checklist link once PRs land. :thumbsup:
